content: SIGKILL cannot be intercepted/handled by the target process (unconditional termination on all platforms). A common deterministic crash-injection pattern: spawn the target as a real child process with an IPC channel (child_process.fork), have the injected fault point send a 'ready-to-kill' IPC message and then hang (never resolve), and have the test harness kill(child.pid, 'SIGKILL') only after receiving that message -- avoiding timing-based/polling kills.
